name: dsh-plugin-google
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin for Google Calendar and Google Tasks: conversational CRUD over events, calendars, tasks and task lists, with built-in OAuth 2.0 loopback authorization
author: alex007

meta.title: Google 日历与任务
meta.description: 通过对话管理 Google 日历与 Google Tasks：日程、日历、待办、任务列表的增删改查、忙闲查询与每日汇总。

summary.en: Google Calendar and Google Tasks for DSH: 30 tools for events, calendars, to-dos and task lists, with built-in OAuth 2.0 desktop authorization and no third-party runtime dependencies.
summary.zh: 把 Google 日历与 Google Tasks 接入 DSH：30 个工具覆盖日程、日历、待办与任务列表的增删改查，内置 OAuth 2.0 桌面授权，零第三方运行时依赖。

capabilities: Calendar events CRUD, including single recurring instances
Cross-calendar event queries with natural-language times
Google Tasks and task lists CRUD, subtasks, cross-list moves
Free/busy lookup across several calendars at once
Daily agenda: events + due tasks + overdue + conflicts
